newsitem.title: CANADA: Sherritt Intl' to issue C$300 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Sherritt Intl' to issue C$300 mln debentures.

text.p: Sherritt International Corp said on Monday that it entered an underwriting agreement to issue C$300 million of 6.0 percent, 10-year convertible debentures.

The unsecured subordinated debentures, represented by instalment receipts, would be issued at par value of C$1,000, Sherritt said. Of that, C$500 is payable when the offer closes and the remaining C$500 on or before December 1, 1997. The underwriters granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to an additional C$300 million principal amount debentures on the same terms.
The conversion price will be C$9.50, equivalent to a conversion rate of 105.263 shares per C$1,000 debenture.
The debenture issue is expected to close by December 4.

Sherritt said it planned to use the proceeds from the offering to finance capital projects and grow its existing businesses. The company said it also planned to pursue investments in Cuba, particularly in sugar, petroleum refining, real estate and communications.
